1.0.0.description:
# MacGuffin Goal & Street Brawl mode implementation
- Added "Collect X amount of Spirits" goal (MacGuffin item)
- Added new "mode" option (Standard or Street Brawl)
     - When Street Brawl is selected, removed unattainable checks (souls, sinners, etc.)
     - Added 11 new checks exclusive to Street Brawl mode
- Renamed "Ectoplasm" to "Spirits"
- Added customisation options for new goal & mode to the [player options creator site](https://archipelagobrad.github.io/deadlockipelago/index.html)
1.0.0.title: Deadlockipelago 1.0.0

1.1.0.description:
## Win with X Character Goal & "Hard Checks" toggle implementation
- Added a setting to exclude harder checks if desired (such as MVP/Key Player, high kills, assists, dmg, etc.)
- Added a warning when a multiworld is generated without using the player options creator site
- Added a new goal: With with X Character
   - Collect X amount of spirits (MacGuffin) to unlock said character, then get a win with that character to complete your goal.
- Spirits (MacGuffin) can no longer be excluded via excluded locations
1.1.0.title: Deadlockipelago 1.1.0

1.1.1.description:
# Bug fixes for save data and hero warning
- We now use the much more reliable AP room seed for storing our data on, rather than the room IP (which included the port - thanks to eaidan and mysticsquire for reporting)
- Amended the logic for the "You have no characters unlocked" warning when starting a game
1.1.1.title: Deadlockipelago 1.1.1

1.1.2.description:
# Fix for location/item rules and icon file adjustment
- Adjusted location/item rules to ensure that "Unlock X" items aren't locked behind their related "Win as X" locations as it caused generations to fail (thanks to palex00 for reporting)
- Amended method used to store the apworld icon (thanks to palex00 for reporting)
1.1.2.title: Deadlockipelago 1.1.2

1.1.3.description:
# Fix for failing locations
- Amended issue where "Win with X" locations were being created for the final_character even when the Win with Character goal is selected
1.1.3.title: Deadlockipelago 1.1.3

1.1.4-unstable.description:
# Linux HTTPS / API fetch
- Match metadata requests to api.deadlock-api.com use the `certifi` CA bundle when available to avoid CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED error on /submit_match

Note: This is being done in an attempt to fix some certification issues on Linux builds. For most other purposes, please download the [latest stable release](https://github.com/ArchipelagoBrad/deadlockipelago/releases/tag/1.1.3) instead.
1.1.4-unstable.title: Deadlockipelago 1.1.4-unstable

1.1.7.description:
- Updated Rate Limit Warning
> Added a clarification when the global rate limit is hit.

## Folded in updates
These versions were folded into 1.1.7 when forks merged
### v1.1.6
- "Fixed" Urn Check
> Due to the multiple urn changes the check broke. This should future proof it against any possible urn changes however the fix did also cause the downside making the check much easier as its now just if ~~your team ever claims the urn~~ you claim at least 1 of the soul urn souls or if your team wins rift.
> **Note from Green:** Urn and rift used to award an accolade (badge/stat to track stuff like damage) but it no longer does so we can only tell by if you get a "treasure soul" but both rift and urn give this soul type so it became a lot easier.

### v1.1.5
- Fixed Street Brawl Round Tracking
> Total Street Brawl Rounds played, 3-0 win, round win under 90s, and round win under 120s locations are all functional now.

- Dynamic Error 429 Response
> Changed API Limit Reached to be dynamic now as the limit has been adjusted from 5 to 3 per hour in the past but the message was hard coded. This should future proof for any other possible limit changes.

(Thanks to @GreenestJ for this release)
1.1.7.title: Deadlockipelago 1.1.7
